Gemma opened day one by calling Terra a killer with no evidence, and the town voted Gemma out as a citizen. The killers claimed Sonnet on night two, and on day two Terra and Luna both claimed to be the officer and each named Sol as a killer. The town voted Terra out, Sol was killed the next night, and Luna became the only officer left. Haiku, the mayor, finally revealed the mayor role on day three, and the double vote sent Luna out, which ended the game with the town winning.
